notes.title: MatchyGotchyZ v0.38 - EA Update: Cards
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/9ad1f9d32f42b8d332871cae7e90005c0a770f84.png

Check out the latest update from the Matchyverse: Cards in MatchyGotchy Z.

We did a poll and we heard the biggest updates people wanted was more games so we are doing just that. Now you can play a game of Memory with your favorite Stars.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/773a03c19470659f7ece3c78b36fa7dc4aaec826.png

There are 3 different decks of cards, and each time you play you get a randomized set of icons to match, so have fun!

We also cleaned up a bit of the user interface. The full Build Logs are on our discord: Silverware Games Discord

Also, we are featuring the Heart of the Matchyverse and our own Derpy Wasabi, Say here on the matchyverse blog: Spotlight on Say

We are hoping to build a community of citizens of the Matchyverse, so if you are excited about the games and want to have a say in the direction the universe goes in just join our streams on discord, Monday at 8pm EST and Friday at 9pm EST right here: Silverware Games Twitch 

Thanks for being part of this adventure! 
-Michael - Matchyverse Cheesy Potato.

notes.title: Big MatchyGotchy Update Coming!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/e7244a735437126b4629c0441f5d2700a3977093.jpg

There is more content coming for MatchyGotchy! We have had all sorts of feedback coming our way, both good and not so good and we have listened to all of it. One consistent request has been that we add more to the game. More food, more games and that’s why we decided to include more of everything! More cleaning, medicine options, and entertainment activities to do with your favorite star. We have also taken into consideration commentaries regarding how part of the experience can be improved and we are revising the difficulty curve of some achievements, as well as the pacing of the game. Considering this is a big update, we are working on a chunk of new content for an affordable DLC to complement what we already have – there will be updates found in the main build too, but most of the new content will be part of a DLC.

For example, we know a lot of people are looking for different games besides the guessing game and we are adding several more including ‘Hacky Sack’ which is a skill based game of clicking and timing. Also, we are including brand new fun things such as an in-game store to customize food and clothing, and ‘Ask the 8 Ball’ mini game to add more fun interactions with your star. There will be new kinds of food with different reactions, new locations including “Matchy Mart” to buy supplies and the “Fitting Room” to customize your pet’s duds.

Including this as a transaction, we can now add the Steam Cards we originally designed! Steam wouldn’t allow cards before because the game was entirely free. Either way, the original MatchyGotchy will continue to be free, this DLC is just an optional extra add on for the Matchyverse community that wants more from the game. If you get to play longer than and hour and want more, then there’s more for you to explore one download away.

If you would like to keep up with news on update, new releases, and even beta testing groups then sign up to our newsletter list.silverwaregames.com, and if you would love to reach out to us then you are welcome to follow us on twitter  @swgspork    and  @sayomgwtf   

If you would like to read up more on this update, stop by our website to check out the full blog entry www.silverwaregames.com
